# Lists and tuples: constructors, access, higher-order builtins.

=== list
(list 1 2 3)
--- want
(list 1 2 3)

=== list evaluates its elements
(list (+ 1 1) (* 2 2))
--- want
(list 2 4)

=== length
(length (list 1 2 3))
--- want
3

=== length empty
(length (list))
--- want
0

=== length tuple
(length (tuple 1 2))
--- want
2

=== length of a string is an error
(length "abc")
--- error

=== head
(head (list 10 20 30))
--- want
10

=== head of empty
(head (list))
--- error

=== head of tuple is an error
(head (tuple 1))
--- error

=== tail
(tail (list 1 2 3))
--- want
(list 2 3)

=== tail of one
(tail (list 1))
--- want
(list)

=== tail of empty
(tail (list))
--- error

=== nth
(nth (list 10 20 30) 1)
--- want
20

=== nth first
(nth (list 10 20 30) 0)
--- want
10

=== nth out of range
(nth (list 1 2) 5)
--- error

=== nth negative
(nth (list 1 2) -1)
--- error

=== nth on tuple is an error
(nth (tuple 1 2) 0)
--- error

=== nth arity
(nth (list 1 2))
--- error

=== list-append
(list-append (list 1) 2)
--- want
(list 1 2)

=== list-append nests a list
(list-append (list 1) (list 2))
--- want
(list 1 (list 2))

=== list-append does not mutate
(let ((xs (list 1))) (list-append xs 2) xs)
--- want
(list 1)

=== list-concat
(list-concat (list 1) (list 2))
--- want
(list 1 2)

=== list-concat three
(list-concat (list 1) (list) (list 2 3))
--- want
(list 1 2 3)

=== list-concat needs two lists
(list-concat (list 1))
--- error

=== list-concat needs lists
(list-concat (list 1) 2)
--- error

=== map
(map (fn (x) (* x 2)) (list 1 2 3))
--- want
(list 2 4 6)

=== map empty
(map (fn (x) x) (list))
--- want
(list)

=== map with a named function
(let () (def sq (fn (x) (* x x))) (map sq (list 1 2 3)))
--- want
(list 1 4 9)

=== map function arity
(map (fn (x y) x) (list 1))
--- error

=== map on tuple is an error
(map (fn (x) x) (tuple 1 2))
--- error

=== filter
(filter (fn (x) (> x 1)) (list 1 2 3))
--- want
(list 2 3)

=== filter keeps none
(filter (fn (x) #f) (list 1 2))
--- want
(list)

=== filter empty
(filter (fn (x) #t) (list))
--- want
(list)

=== filter predicate must return a bool
(filter (fn (x) x) (list 1 2))
--- error

=== fold
(fold (fn (acc x) (+ acc x)) 0 (list 1 2 3 4))
--- want
10

=== fold empty returns init
(fold (fn (acc x) (+ acc x)) 7 (list))
--- want
7

=== fold builds a list
(fold (fn (acc x) (list-append acc (* x x))) (list) (list 1 2 3))
--- want
(list 1 4 9)

=== range one argument
(range 3)
--- want
(list 0 1 2)

=== range two arguments
(range 2 5)
--- want
(list 2 3 4)

=== range non-increasing is empty
(range 5 2)
--- want
(list)

=== range zero
(range 0)
--- want
(list)

=== range negative start
(range -2 1)
--- want
(list -2 -1 0)

=== range arity
(range)
--- error

=== reverse
(reverse (list 1 2 3))
--- want
(list 3 2 1)

=== reverse empty
(reverse (list))
--- want
(list)

=== reverse on tuple is an error
(reverse (tuple 1 2))
--- error

=== is-empty list
(is-empty (list))
--- want
#t

=== is-empty non-empty list
(is-empty (list 1))
--- want
#f

=== is-empty string
(is-empty "")
--- want
#t

=== is-empty non-empty string
(is-empty "a")
--- want
#f

=== is-empty tuple
(is-empty (tuple))
--- want
#t

=== is-empty number
(is-empty 5)
--- want
#f

=== is-nil empty list
(is-nil (list))
--- want
#t

=== is-nil non-empty list
(is-nil (list 1))
--- want
#f

=== is-nil tuple is not nil
(is-nil (tuple))
--- want
#f

=== is-nil number
(is-nil 0)
--- want
#f

=== composed pipeline
(fold (fn (acc x) (+ acc x)) 0 (map (fn (x) (* x x)) (filter (fn (x) (> x 1)) (range 5))))
--- want
29
